content: Kalan Cathut lawkcengnae lunghawi lawk dei ratoumnae

content.text: Oe Cathut, nang koe lunghawi lawk ka dei, lunghawi lawk ka dei.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na sak e kângairu hnonaw ni
na min a hnainae a kamnue sak.
Kâdawk e tueng a pha toteh,
kânging lah lawk na ceng han.
Talai hoi a thung kaawm e naw pueng raphoe lah ao teh,
a khom hah kacaklah a ung. Selah.
Mithmaikhet e naw koevah, minhmai khen hanh awh.
Tamikathoutnaw koe na ki hno hanh.
Na ki teh a lathueng lah saw sak hanh awh.
Lahuen pata lahoi lawk dei hanh awh telah ka ti.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tawmnae teh kanîtho,
kanîloum, akalah hoi tho hoeh.
Hateiteh, Cathut teh lawkcengkung doeh.
Buet touh a rahnoum sak teh alouke a rasang sak.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut kut dawk manang ao teh,
misurtui teh a paling.
Koung kalawt hnukkhu a rabawk.
A laheipadin totouh talai van e tamikayonnaw ni
koung a nei awh han.
Hateiteh, Jakop Cathut teh, ka pholen han,
a yungyoe ka pholen han.
Tamikayon e ki pueng teh,
koung ka tâtueng han.
Hateiteh, tamikalan e ki teh,
tawm lah ao han.
